system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Crafting and Performance, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Puppetry Lore, Stage Mechanisms Lore, Theater Lore.
system.description: You built figures and gave them a life before an audience. You learned how a small movement could hold a room's attention and how to repair a tangled mechanism before anyone noticed.
